reason: As written, the finding fails the value check and repeats a governance line we already rejected. (1) It is the R15FP-1 pattern again. The round-15 judge rejected world counts for this exact class-C table (round15/report.json 'rejected': R15FP-1 12-world counts; IDEAS.md I-092 is refuted; I-344 says the reason is qualitative only). The source notes themselves call the MC 'illustration, not a decision input per I-092'. Even so, the action hands the user 18-world point values (0.57/0.18, 0.72/0.41, ...) as the basis for a finals change. The absolute levels rest on unobservable judgmental inputs (field growth r, genuine share g, beta, rho, copy-as-second-final k, and the d mixture with mean ~0). (2) The key safety claim is overstated. 'Not worse than no change even if DC transfers adversely' and '(b) never worse than (a) by more than ~0.01' are false. My independent check (scratchpad hedge.py, 400k draws; #37 = X+I, #38 = X+eps where eps = 0 ties and loses to earlier copies, V*_C = X+I+d, three bronze-margin settings, optimistic and pessimistic I) gives b-a from -0.008 to +0.050 under the lab prior N(-0.8,1.2)e-3. Under a harsh prior N(-3,1.5)e-3 (dc0.30 moved the public display by -0.005) it gives -0.042 to +0.001. The finding's own r16fc-4 bound on the twin's hedge value is 0.06. The loss is small and bounded, but not ~0. (3) What survives is qualitative and mostly known. (c) {V*_C, #38} is dominated (R15-A8 (1)), and my check confirms it: -0.14 to -0.57 vs (a) under lab or harsh d. (b) >= (a) in most settings because the #38 hedge pays only when I<0, eps>0 and X+ lands inside bronze. The field-growth premise (r16fc-2/4) is new and legitimately weakens that hedge. (4) Option (B) {exp70b,#38}: +0.02/+0.05 is inside model error and rests on fm45 (forkmid is closed as a mechanism). It is not decision-worthy, and the brief already asked about it. Feasibility is fine: 43/44 are still PENDING at the 08:45Z check (poll.log l.12833/12835), no build, submit or runtime is needed, and a letter logged before the first terminal header counts as pre-registered under R15-A1 (4).
fix: Do not send the MC table or its point values. Before the first poll.log header that shows 56598763/56598765 terminal, send one qualitative line inside the existing R15-A1 (4) mechanics: 'If 43/44 display >= 0.955: (b) {V*_C, #37} keeps #37 as the floor and replaces only the no-insertion twin #38. In the grown field (>=0.954 public group ~358 now, heading to 500+), #38 helps only if the insertion is negative on private AND lowrefine's eps > 0 AND an x138-level file still medals. So (b) is likely >= (a); it can lose a few points of P(bronze) (~0.01-0.05) if DC hurts on the private embryos, as the only lab read, 6bba dc0.20 -0.0008, suggests. (c) {V*_C, #38} is not recommended. Default without your letter: no change {#37,#38}.' Prefer #37 over exp70b as the partner of V*_C (the fm45 upside is unproven). Log the letter with date -u. Any later letter is labelled USER DECISION AFTER SCORE.
realistic_gain: The information is worth ~0. The decision it informs matters only in the class-C world (P ~0.15-0.25), where choosing (b) over (a) moves P(bronze) by about -0.04 to +0.05 under lab-anchored or adverse DC priors (up to +0.15 only under a neutral transfer prior). The expected gain is roughly 0.00-0.02 P(bronze), and there is no change to P(gold).
